title: Multiplier from a noisy spec
prompt: A loyalty program: **Gold** members earn 3 points per dollar, **Silver** members earn 2. On **Friday** (day 5, with days numbered 1=Monday … 7=Sunday) everyone earns double. Implement `multiplier(String tier, int day)`.

tests.name: gold friday
tests.hint: Base by tier, then double only when day == 5.
